name: Jiajun Chen
intro: I am a final-year undergraduate studying Data Science and Big Data Technology at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications. During my senior year, I am visiting the National University of Singapore through its Non-Graduating Non-Exchanging Programme.

At NUS, I work as a research intern at the Computer Vision and Machine Learning Lab, advised by Prof. Angela Yao and Dr. Junbin Xiao. I am seeking PhD opportunities in video understanding, long-term memory, and world models.
